details:
Reading the signal
- **Seismograph:** one swing of the pen per day of the last 365. The bigger the swing, the busier the day. Orange bands mark hyperfocus episodes, the most intense runs of back-to-back busy days. The biggest, HF-1, ran 3 days and logged 94 contributions. - **Time, as experienced:** there are two times, now and not now. The bars under the clock are contributions by weekday (busiest: Sun). - **Counters:** longest streak, contributions in the last 12 months, active days, stars, followers and years on GitHub. - **Dopamine by source:** language share by bytes across public repositories. - **The opening shot:** autofocus hunts through the noise, then locks on. The out-of-focus lights behind it are the last 12 months, one per month; bigger and brighter means busier.
ADHD isn’t a shortage of attention. Attention goes where interest is, and when it gets there it locks on hard. Artwork: original animated SVG, generated by README Templates · template: ADHD. Motion stops if your system asks for reduced motion.

img.alt: A film slate snaps shut: that's a wrap. Thanks for your attention. I know it’s a limited resource.
